analysis_label: Conditional SMICA joint morphology and processing sensitivity

declaration.analysis_label: Conditional SMICA joint morphology and processing sensitivity
declaration.null_model_id: delivered fixed-weight FFP10 SMICA signal plus separately delivered independent noise; exchangeability conditional assumption
declaration.predeclaration_scope: features/mask/tails/split fixed before this pilot's numerical scores; retrospective project-level selection, nonconfirmatory
declaration.simulation_independence_status: conditional on delivered independent simulation model; unique IDs alone do not establish independence

current_selection.residual_dipole: fit nuisance retained descriptively, excluded from rank family
current_selection.historical_selection: same observed sky; unknown complete historical trial family, not corrected by this max

feature_conventions.chirality: v dot (Qv cross Av)/[|v||Qv||Av|], v_i=O_ijk Q_jk; parity odd
feature_conventions.frame: Galactic Cartesian; shapes SO(3) invariant; full tensors retained

interpretation.rank: Max over all48 current processing/statistic choices; conditional delivered-simulation exchangeability assumed. Historical unrecorded choices and physical adequacy unresolved.
interpretation.interval: Marginal Clopper-Pearson interval for IID null exceedance probability q conditional on fixed observed threshold and training. Not an interval for realized p_rank; not simultaneous across features.
interpretation.multiplicity: Global max-score test and single-step adjusted ranks control error under the complete joint null. Strong FWER under partial alternatives needs extra conditions, not asserted.
interpretation.physical_scope: Observed feature calibration; no inferred shear, global tilt, Bianchi family detection, posterior or evidence.
